column3: The Cottage Cove Apartments Mortgage Loan (8.2%), for which Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC is the mortgage loan seller, is part of a Whole Loan that was co-originated by Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC and Starwood Mortgage Capital LLC. Such Mortgage Loan was underwritten pursuant to Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC’s and Starwood Mortgage Capital LLC’s underwriting guidelines.
